benefitScreen.screen: In each regime, EDMD must reduce mean 50 ms RMSE by at least 10 percent against each of the three baselines, win at least 7 of 10 paired runs against each, and produce no nonfinite tested forecasts.

scope: Offline shadow prototype with synchronous healthy data and recorded future voltage sequences; no receiver, EMI exposure, packet-recovery, control intervention, hardware or closed-loop stability claim.
